problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & a \\ 0 & b\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)=6{x}_{1}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+3{x}_{2}{y}_{2}$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b?$
worked_solution:
Each term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form corresponds to the entry ${a}_{ij}$ of the matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & =6{x}_{1}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+3{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =6{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+(-2){x}_{1}{y}_{2} \\  & +\,0{x}_{2}{y}_{1}\,+3{x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, the corresponding matrix of the bilinear form is

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & -2 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-2$ and $b=3.$ Finally, 

$$
a+b=(-2)+3=1.
$$
